about_the_game:
This is your Lucky Break! You've matched with three beautiful women and now it's time to go on dates with them and find the one... or maybe not. The choice is yours.

Step into the shoes of an everyday construction worker whose luck is about to change dramatically. After months of silence on dating apps, fate delivers an unexpected gift: three stunning matches in a single day. Each woman is unique, mysterious, and genuinely interested in meeting you.

Alexandra - The brilliant and enigmatic analyst from a prestigious investment bank who sees right through people's facades. Navigate her world of calculated conversations and discover the warmth hidden beneath her professional exterior.

Carina - A vibrant waitress at a bustling Mexican restaurant who dreams of opening her own fusion kitchen. Her infectious laughter and flirtatious charm hide an intensity that could either sweep you off your feet or consume you entirely.

Ellie - A thoughtful barista and aspiring artist who sees beauty in life's quiet moments. Behind her shy exterior lies a poetic heart and creative spirit just waiting for someone who appreciates her unique perspective on the world.

Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Russian

Your Choices Shape Everything

Meaningful Decisions: Every dialogue choice and action influences how your dates unfold and determines your romantic future

Dynamic Storytelling: Multiple conversation paths and branching narratives lead to dramatically different outcomes

Replayable Romance: Explore different approaches to unlock new scenes, dialogue, and relationship endings

Key Features

🎬 Cinematic FMV Experience: High-quality video scenes with professional voice acting bring each character to life

💕 Mature Romance: Thoughtful, adult-oriented storytelling with suggestive but tasteful content

🎭 Choice-Driven Narrative: Your personality and decisions create unique romantic storylines for each woman

🎯 Multiple Endings: From heartbreak to happily ever after – your choices determine the final outcome

Will you play it safe or take risks? Be yourself or become who you think they want? In Lucky Break, every choice matters, and your perfect match might surprise you.
